description: Objects with different attribute names unify to a map
notes: The spec unifies two object types to an object type with the union of their attributes, and object conversion fills a missing attribute with null, giving {a = 1, b = null}. hashicorp/hcl unifies objects with different attribute names to a map of their unified attribute types (unifyObjectTypesToMap in cty/convert/unify.go), so it never performs that conversion.
